primary_source.title: How we cut Vertex AI latency by 35% with GKE Inference Gateway

connection: Google increased the queue-depth weight so cached but overloaded replicas could be bypassed. This supports choosing idle B with 0.8s recomputation over A with a 3s queue. Our measured fix removes ClientIP affinity in a CPU simulator; it does not reproduce Google's inference gateway, KV cache, or token-level results.
